It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. steps.name: assert-no-catalog-btn-overview
steps.eval: if(document.querySelector('.m-catalog-btn')) throw new Error('catalog btn should be hidden outside room editor'); 'ok'

steps.name: assert-left-of-hamburger
steps.eval: const bar=document.querySelector('.toolbar.mobilebar'); const kids=[...bar.children]; const cat=kids.findIndex(k=>k.classList.contains('m-catalog-btn')); const ham=kids.findIndex(k=>k.classList.contains('m-menu-btn')); if(cat<0||ham<0) throw new Error('missing btn cat='+cat+' ham='+ham); if(cat>=ham) throw new Error('catalog not left of hamburger cat='+cat+' ham='+ham); 'ok cat='+cat+' ham='+ham
